workItems.title: Technical architecture — data model, API design, pipeline integration approach
Design spec — reviews page, gate config UI, deliverable viewer, approve/reject flow
Backend — review data model, CRUD API endpoints, project schema extension
Frontend — reviews page, project gate settings, inline deliverable rendering
Pipeline integration — heartbeat gate checking and pause/resume logic
QA pass
workItems.description: FAIL — 2 major bugs + 1 missing feature must be fixed before shipping

workItems.title: Fix: Deliverable doc viewer uses wrong URL pattern (404 on load)
workItems.description: reviews.html line 738 fetches /docs/ + deliverable.path, but path includes docs/ prefix. Should use /api/docs/ + filename (strip docs/ prefix). Currently all deliverable docs fail to render.

workItems.title: Fix: Approve button requires double-click (should only apply to keyboard shortcut)
workItems.description: approveReview() uses approveConfirmActive for both onclick and keyboard A-key. Design spec says double-press confirmation is only for keyboard shortcut. Button click should approve in one press.

workItems.title: Add pending reviews metric card to dashboard.html
workItems.description: AC6 requires pending reviews visible on dashboard with count badge. The API returns pendingReviews in metrics but dashboard.html has no metric card for it. Design spec section 3.2 specifies the layout.

workItems.title: Minor: Dashboard nav badge uses inline styles instead of shared .review-nav-badge class
workItems.description: dashboard.html line 164 uses style= for the nav badge instead of the .review-nav-badge class defined in reviews.html. Not blocking but inconsistent.

workItems.title: Minor: Duplicate Zod validation messages on empty feedback
workItems.description: PATCH /api/reviews/:id with {status: changes-requested, feedback: ''} returns the same error message twice. Both .min(1) and .refine() fire. Cosmetic — not blocking.
